snippet.title: SpinWhisker - TRAILER
snippet.description:
Nobody even knows how this cat got here or how to help him go back home. He strayed too far and accidentally entered a portal to another dimension. Now he's doing whatever it takes to escape.

The trip will be rough... there are many DANGEROUS obstacles on the way... But still, one thing remains clear. He's NEVER quitting.

PLAY NOW: https://gustavoegato.itch.io/spinwhisker
